items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Desvignes. All kind of bands came through. ... they would let me come to the dances. I could go in free and listen to the bands.

ctx.x:
Desvignes. All kind of bands came through.
And by me being a musician, ha-ha!, they would let me come to the dances. I could go in free and listen to the bands. So I could get a chance to hear everybody. I was the only kid in the place, but I could hear everybody -- they'd let me in. Because they all knew me around home, you know. Everybody knew me. And it really enhanced me. It enhanced me...
